Verizon is seeking a Product Engineer for its Business Product Engineering organization. The role focuses on bridging technical engineering teams and business operations to simplify 4G/5G Private Wireless Networks, build a clear and actionable central dashboard, and translate customer needs into product features and technical requirements.

Responsibilities
Collaborating directly with customers and business product managers to gather requirements and translate them into actionable product features
Guiding the product roadmap to meet enterprise customer needs effectively
User Stories & Planning: Translating customer needs into clear user stories and testable Acceptance Criteria (AC) for engineering teams
Technical Collaboration: Partnering with developers to build, test, and release features, using zero-touch automation to streamline deployment
System Architecture: Driving the system architecture design for the dashboard while leading architectural solutions for new product requirements
Data & Dashboards: Turning complex network metrics (Core/RAN health, signaling, RF performance) into simple, clear dashboards and reports
AIOps & Alerting: Bringing AIOps capabilities to simplify the user experience, enhance operational efficiency, enable proactive anomaly notifications and define alerting thresholds to reduce redundant noise and provide clear troubleshooting steps

Required
Bachelor's degree or one or more years of work experience
Experience in technical product management with skills in writing user stories and AC in engineering environments
Experience in 4G/5G network and understanding of Core and RAN technologies to diagnose connection issues and performance bottlenecks
Knowledge of security integration and vulnerability management tools including Prisma, Twistlock, and SonarQube
Preferred
Knowledge of 3GPP standards and protocols (SIP, Diameter, IPSec, TCP/UDP is a plus)
Advance knowledge of AIOps and the development of predictive network models for real-time orchestration
Agile Sprint Execution: Lead sprint refinement, backlog grooming, and release planning within an Agile software delivery environment to translate enterprise customer needs into prioritized epics and user stories
Experience in cross-functional collaboration/leadership, ability to balance priorities between business stakeholders, operations, and development teams
Knowledge of Figma for crafting intuitive UI/UX designs that elevate the end-user customer experience
Experience in constructing real-time dashboards utilizing APIs, WebSockets, and event-driven architectures
Familiarity with distributed database architectures (MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra) to understand the storage layer's impact on dashboard performance
